messages.body_plain:
Hello TIng,
Sorry for the late reply. I wanted to reanalyze the data with the newest version of MSStats and reran the analysis (with adjusted commands).
I run into the following problem:

 test.byproposed <- groupComparisonTMT(data = quant_protein, contrast.matrix = comparison, adj.method = "BH")
Error in .proposed.model(data, moderated, contrast.matrix, adj.method) :
  Please check the contrast.matrix. Column names of contrast.matrix. must be matched with conditions!

However, I checked the spelling and the conditions should be correct in the contrast.matrix. To make sure, I used a dynamic approach:

comparison<-matrix(c(0,0,-1,1),nrow=1)
row.names(comparison)<-"Recurring - Primary"
colnames(comparison)<- as.character(levels(quant_protein$Condition))

Do you have any idea why after the update the analysis does not work anymore at this point?

Best,
Klemens

messages.body_plain:
Hi Klemens,

Cloud you print out "as.character(levels(quant_protein$Condition))".  I guess it has "Norm" as condition, which we shouldn't include as columns of the contrast. See the example

# 'Norm' should be not considered in the contrast
comparison<-matrix(c(-1,0,0,1),nrow=1)

# Set the names of each row row.names(comparison)<-"1-0.125"

# Set the column names and 'Norm' should be not considered in the contrast

colnames(comparison)<- c("0.125", "0.5", "0.667", "1")

Best,
Ting

messages.body_plain:
Dear MSStats TMT Team,

I also started to use MSStatsTMT for my analysis and I updated to the Version 1.2.1.

When I open the documentation for the MaxQtoMSstatsTMTFormat {MSstatsTMT} fuction I can find the following hints for the annotation file:

data frame which contains column Run, Fraction, TechRepMixture, Mixture, Channel, BioReplicate, Condition. Refer to the example 'annotation.mq <http://annotation.mq>' for the meaning of each column.

What exactly is meant by TechRepMixture & Fraction?

So far my annotation file looks like the following:

Run Channel Condition Mixture BioReplicate
BM4141 channel.0 high Mixture1 4563
BM4141 channel.1 low Mixture1 10466
BM4141 channel.2 NA Mixture1 4630
BM4141 channel.3 low Mixture1 51487
.....

Thanks for any help regarding this matter.

Best regards
Matthias
